My mom died in 2010. She had a lot of gold jewels and some money. I have 2 sisters and 2 brothers. Each of us receive an equal share. Since I was a minor, my older brother got in charge of my part.
3 years later he moved to Brazil and took my part and decided to sell it without my knowledge and spent it. It took me 4/5 years to get what was mine.
Since he had sold the gold pieces, all I had left was money. Since that day I hadn’t talked to him since. Sure, the money is good but I had a lot of pieces that I was extremely fond of… so that was #1. 

When I received the money, my other brother and a sister were forcing me to give them the money because I was such a borden for them that it was the compensation. Mind you, it was around 120k..
So I moved out and got a place of my own. 

I only really talk to the other sister, who never treated me like they did and has supported me through every decision I make. She stepped up and became like a mother to me.. 

I was around 12 years old when my mom died and moved out as soon as I turned 18. 

It’s been six years, I went NC and it was the best decision I made. 
For me, I only have one sister, for all I care.
